from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the case (e.g., 民事，行政，刑事)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
